# template-oss

> A template for open-source TypeScript projects: a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo
> with one publishable package, an Astro Starlight docs site, and CI from
> rxova/shared. Replace this summary with what the project does. MIT.

This file is an index. It points to the files that document the project and
restates none of their content, so there is nothing here to drift from the
source.

## Packages

Each package ships its `llms.txt` inside its tarball, so after an install it can
be read from `node_modules/<package>/llms.txt` with no network access.

- [@rxova/example](packages/example/llms.txt): the install line, the API, a
  working example, and the mistakes to avoid.

## Docs

Every page of the documentation site also exists as raw markdown — add `.md` to
any URL — and the site serves its own `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt`.

- [README](packages/example/README.md): install and an example. Also in the
  tarball.

## Contributing

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules and commands for an agent editing this
  repository.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, the quality gates, commits,
  changesets and releases.
- [README.md](README.md): the workspace, CI and the release process.
